title: A part sale's representative field is unchanged from Part Sales Update v1
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "partsale-00-b-ps.png" (board 3.0), "partsale-01-n3-rest.png" (board 3.1), "partsale-02-n3-hover.png" (board 3.2), "partsale-03-n3-list.png" (board 3.3) and "partsale-04-n3-picked-hover.png" (board 3.4) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Part sale {Part-sale-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced.
    For example: {Part-sale-1} is P-30001.
  • Starting screen: {Part-sale-1} is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Compare the Sales Representative field with the picture of board 3.1.
  2. Hover over it and compare with the picture of board 3.2.
  3. Open its list and compare with the picture of board 3.3.
  4. Pick {Sales-rep-A}, hover and compare with the picture of board 3.4.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: one "Sales Representative" field, plain text at rest, the full width of the card; no + and no remove x.
  • Step 2: Part Sales Update v1's own hover box and arrow, the full width of the card.
  • Step 3: the list as in the picture.
  • Step 4: {Sales-rep-A} in the same field, still no + and no remove x.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-N2, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 3.0 Before: a part sale today; 3.1 The Sales Representative field; 3.2 Hover; 3.3 The list; 3.4 A rep picked, hovered (the attached pictures are these boards). Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

The tech plan rebuilds this field on the new work order field and changes its label case ("Sales representative" to "Sales Representative"); the PRD says nothing about it changes. That is on the product owner's question sheet.
